verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's docs confirm automatic grouping of identical errors into a single issue with navigation across occurrences, and explicit customization via error class, component, stack trace, or custom fingerprint when grouping is wrong, plus community feedback praising 'deduping.' missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence of fingerprinting accuracy at scale (thousands of duplicates) or detailed walkthrough of the custom fingerprint API.
